behaviors.behavior: a PascalCase-component describe prefix is stripped and a clean it-label survives on its own
a dirty it-label with no clean fallback is dropped entirely
a bare (no describe wrapper) dirty it/test label with no prefix to strip is dropped
a blank/whitespace-only it/test label is dropped rather than emitted as an empty bullet
an empty it-label under a dirty describe is dropped, not smuggled through as a blank bullet by the prefix-strip fallback
an it is attributed to its single innermost describe only; a dirty outer describe never enters the combined string and cannot trip or need stripping
two distinct dirty-prefixed bullets that collapse to the same clean it text after stripping are deduped, first-seen order preserved
per-file dedup also applies to bullets that were never stripped (genuine source-file duplication)
a JS candidate file whose every raw label is dirty yields an empty bullet list
a Python candidate file whose every raw label is dirty yields an empty bullet list
an all-underscore Python test name humanizes to a whitespace-only string and is dropped rather than emitted as a blank bullet
a dirty Python docstring-derived bullet is dropped
a dirty Python humanized-name bullet (no docstring) is dropped rather than emitted half-humanized
a candidate file whose every raw label is dirty falls through to the next sibling candidate, same as a file with no test calls at all
hygiene filtering happens before the 10-item cap, so dirty candidates never consume a cap slot
test_acceptance_miner is the 9th plugin module to resolve fr_hygiene_detectors via the shared_loader.load_shared_module idiom, pinned by the cross-plugin census test

surface_verification.justification: Pure Python string-filtering logic inside plugins/shipwright-adopt/scripts/lib/test_acceptance_miner.py's mining helper (hygiene filter against the shared fr_hygiene_detectors gate). No startable web/cli/api surface exists to drive: the change is a library function invoked by /shipwright-adopt's onboarding pipeline at analysis time, not an independently launchable process. Covered by 27 unit tests (12 pre-existing + 15 new hygiene tests) exercising every branch (JS combined/prefix-strip/drop, Python docstring/humanized-name/drop, dedup, cap-vs-filter ordering, all-dirty fallthrough).
